content:
Here are the idiomatic Crossplane `CompositeResourceDefinition` (XRD) and `Composition` using the modern `function-patch-and-transform` pipeline mode.

### 1. XRD (CompositeResourceDefinition)
Defines the API surface for consumers. Parameters drive environment-specific sizing, encryption, and trust policies. Status fields expose provisioned ARNs/endpoints for downstream claims or claims composition.

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: appinfrastructures.infrastructure.example.com
spec:
  group: infrastructure.example.com
  names:
    kind: AppInfrastructure
    plural: appinfrastructures
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              parameters:
                type: object
                properties:
                  environment:
                    type: string
                    enum: [dev, prod]
                    description: Target environment. Drives sizing & policy constraints.
                  region:
                    type: string
                    description: AWS region where resources are provisioned.
                  bucketEncryption:
                    type: string
                    enum: [AES256, aws:kms]
                    default: AES256
                  rdsInstanceClass:
                    type: string
                    default: db.t3.micro
                  rdsMultiAZ:
                    type: boolean
                    default: false
                  rdsBackupRetentionDays:
                    type: integer
                    default: 7
                    minimum: 7
                  iamRoleName:
                    type: string
                  iamTrustPolicy:
                    type: object
                    description: OIDC assume-role policy document for workload identity.
                  iamPolicyArns:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: string
                    description: ARNs of managed policies to attach (least-privilege).
                required:
                - environment
                - region
                - iamRoleName
                - iamTrustPolicy
                - iamPolicyArns
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketArn:
                  type: string
                dbEndpoint:
                  type: string
                dbStatus:
                  type: string
```

### 2. Composition (Function Pipeline Mode)
Uses `mode: Pipeline` with the `crossplane-function-patch-and-transform` function. Resources are declaratively defined with `base` specs, and `patches`/`transforms` are evaluated by the function at reconciliation time.

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: aws-app-infrastructure
  labels:
    infrastructure.crossplane.io/stack: canonical-spine
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: infrastructure.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: AppInfrastructure
  mode: Pipeline
  functions:
    - name: patch-and-transform
      function:
        ref:
          name: crossplane-function-patch-and-transform
  resources:

    # 1. S3 Bucket: Versioning, SSE, Public Access Blocked
    - name: app-assets-bucket
      base:
        apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Bucket
        metadata:
          labels:
            app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: crossplane
        spec:
          forProvider:
            region: us-east-1
            versioningConfiguration:
              status: Enabled
            serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
              rules:
                - applyServerSideEncryption
